# Determine the maximum point difference (wildcats points - opponents) across all games
df['point_diff'] = df['wildcats points'] - df['opponents']
max_diff = df['point_diff'].max()
# Find the opponent corresponding to the maximum point difference
max_diff_opponent = df.loc[df['point_diff'] == max_diff, 'opponent'].iloc[0]
# Check if the opponent with the maximum point difference is the one mentioned (Evansville, which had a 36 point difference)
answer = (max_diff_opponent == 'evansville')
